data.one_liner: Change your web favicon and Android application icon programmatically at runtime.
data.what_it_does: Provides a way to dynamically change the website favicon or Android application icon via plugin methods. It allows toggling between predefined activity aliases on Android and updating favicon elements on the web.
use_when: You need to change the app icon dynamically based on user preferences or app state on Android.
You want to programmatically change the website favicon in a Flutter web application.
avoid_when: You just want to set a static launcher icon once at build time.
You need iOS support for dynamic app icons (not currently documented as supported).
strengths: Supports both Android runtime icon switching and web favicon updates.
Migrated to package:web to compile to WASM.
weaknesses: Requires manual and complex configuration of activity aliases in AndroidManifest.xml.
Android implementation requires specific IDE and main activity adjustments.
data.setup_notes: Requires AndroidManifest.xml modifications, setting up activity-aliases, and specific Android activity configuration.

alternatives.name: flutter_launcher_icons
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use flutter_launcher_icons if you want to statically generate and configure your app icons for various platforms at build time rather than changing them dynamically at runtime.
